name: Gold & Ruin
storyline:
Calling all adventurers!

Equip yourself with your trusty whip and take on this procedurally-generated, retro-styled roguelite!

You play as Hugh, an adventurer with a disregard for danger and a lust for gold. Explore a magical, uncharted island with five different ever-changing temples, each larger--and more dangerous--than the last.

Take on snakes, spiders, skeletons, and more as you make your way through each temple's five levels and defeat the temple guardian! Whatever you do, don't die--if you do, you'll start over at the beginning of the temple.

- Fast-paced, punishing Roguelite features per-temple permadeath, balancing progress on the island with a high-risk challenge.
- 16-bit-inspired graphics: an homage to the original Legend of Zelda games while remaining something new.
- Coming Soon: Spend your gold at the traveling merchant's caravan and gear up!
